title: Tongariro Alpine Crossing: A Love Letter and a Warning
description: 19.4 kilometres past an active volcano, and the most beautiful day walk in the country when the weather cooperates — which it did not, the first time. What the Emerald Lakes actually look like in person, how the shuttle logistics work from Taupo, and the gear list I wish someone had forced on me before attempt number one.

comments.comment: The 'warning' half of this should be mandatory reading. We saw people starting at midday in sneakers and a singlet.
Did you book the shuttle both ways or just the drop-off? Trying to figure out if the return timing is tight.
Both ways with the same company — they run returns until 4:30pm so you'd have to really dawdle to miss it.
